description: MXTracker (https://mxtracker.app),  is a modern, cross-platform application built with React Native (Expo) and TypeScript, designed to serve as a comprehensive digital garage for vehicle maintenance management. The platform leverages a scalable cloud backend powered by Supabase to manage the entire user lifecycle, including secure authentication, identity management, and persistent storage of maintenance records. The application utilizes PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS) to ensure that vehicle data and detailed service logs remain isolated and secure for each user across iOS, Android, and web platforms. Beyond simple record-keeping, the platform features a sophisticated automated notification engine utilizing Supabase Edge Functions and pg_cron to trigger timezone-aware email reminders via the Resend API. A core feature is the specialized PDF export functionality, which generates professional maintenance reports including creation and modification timestamps to ensure data transparency. To prevent tampering during private-party vehicle sales, each report includes a unique document hash that can be validated via a dedicated 'verify' endpoint. This integration of edge computing, cryptographic document verification, and file-based routing via Expo Router ensures a high-performance, trustworthy experience for maintaining and proving long-term vehicle health.

skillsUsed: Python, PyAudio, NumPy, Termcolor, Data Structures and Algorithms, Git, GitHub
description: AV-B/DFS is an interactive command-line tool that visualizes Binary Search Tree (BST) traversal algorithms while incorporating musical feedback for a unique learning experience. The tool allows users to input or generate random data, which is mapped to musical notes and structured into a BST. As traversal algorithms like Breadth-First Search (BFS) or Depth-First Search (DFS) are performed, each visited node plays its corresponding note, providing real-time audio and visual feedback. I implemented balanced tree construction, support for common traversal algorithms (in-order, pre-order, post-order), and interactive menu-driven functionality to enhance user engagement. Additionally, the program dynamically renders the BST structure in a readable format, synchronizing traversal order with audio playback to reinforce algorithmic concepts.
